label: Solemnity of Mary, Mother of God (Gregorian Missal)

chants.vernacular_text: Hail holy Mother, the Child-Bearer who has brought forth the King, the ruler of heaven and earth for ever. ℣. My heart overflows with a goodly theme; I address my works to the King.

Radiant light will shine upon us today, for the Lord is born unto us. He shall be called Wonderful God, Prince of Peace, Father of the world to come. His reign shall have no end. ℣. The Lord reigns, he is enrobed with majesty; the Lord is clothed with strength, he has girded himself.
Grace is poured out upon your lips; therefore has God blessed you for ever. ℣. For the cause of truth and goodness and righteousness, your right hand shall lead you wonderfully.
After giving birth you remained a virgin untainted; O Mother of God, intercede for us.
On many occasions in the past, God spoke through the prophets; at long last, in these present days, he has spoken to us through his Son.
Blessed are you, a holy Virgin Mary, and worthy of all praise; for from you has come forth the sun of justice, Christ our God.
Exult, O daughter of Zion, sing praises, O daughter of Jerusalem; behold, your King is coming, the Holy One, the Saviour of the world.
